sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Automated Dropshipping Networks

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law foundation; corporate and trust law influenced by Common Law models)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States – Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, effective 2012)
Panama – Republic of Korea Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (2013)
Panama – United Kingdom Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (2019)
Panama – Kingdom of the Netherlands Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (2010)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley Nº 3 de 22 de enero de 2015 (AML/CFT framework) as amended; Decreto Ejecutivo Nº 466 de 23 de diciembre de 2015 (implementing regulations); Ley Nº 129 de 12 de marzo de 2020 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales / UBO register); and Ley Nº 32 de 1927 (general corporation law for Sociedad Anónima).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport or national identification of each proposed shareholder, director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry or passport authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Hague Convention member) or Consular Legalization (non-member jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder General/Especial) appointing the Panamanian resident agent and incorporation counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the jurisdiction where the principal resides
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization before delivery to the Panamanian notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Clean Criminal Record / Police Clearance Certificate for directors and beneficial owners (if required by the resident agent's KYC policy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police / ministry of justice of the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and UBOs against (i) the Panamanian UAF list of designated persons, (ii) OFAC SDN list, (iii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, (iv) national PEP database and (v) adverse media/negative news; enhanced due diligence is required for the automated dropshipping model because onboarding is non-face-to-face and payment rails include cross-border third-party processor flows; all screening evidence must be kept electronically for at least five years under Law 3/2015.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – online name reservation and certificate system (Sistema de Certificado de Nombre y Reserva)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must use Latin characters; registry filings and official documentation are in Spanish; a name in a non-Latin script must be transliterated; the name must include or be followed by the suffix 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within five business days of a rejection, the applicant may file a reconsideration petition (recurso de reconsideración) with the same registry officer, followed if necessary by a hierarchical appeal (recurso de apelación) to the Director General of the Registro Público de Panamá; the appeal must cite the registrability grounds, submit comparable names and attach the draft by-laws; after exhaustion of administrative remedies, a court challenge may be brought in the Third Chamber of the Supreme Court of Panama.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are legally permissible at the registration level when supplied by a licensed resident agent and accompanied by a registered local address; however, such virtual presence will not satisfy economic-substance expectations and is generally unsuitable for opening correspondent bank accounts or completing in-person compliance verification for payment processors such as Stripe and PayPal.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low–Medium risk; unannounced inspections are primarily directed at licensed resident agents and regulated financial institutions; for a passive automated dropshipping vehicle the expected annual probability of a physical registry/AML inspection is approximately 10–15%, increasing above 35% if a PEP or sanctions red flag emerges.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name reservation and availability certificate
Legal drafting of by-laws and notarial public deed (Escritura Pública)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard digital-commerce S.A.
Statutory tariff based on authorized capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO disclosure filing and AML/KYC compliance kit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed compliance fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening per individual
Notarization, apostille and/or consular legalization of origin-country documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign notary / apostille office / Panamanian consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutory fee plus courier costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year registered agent and registered office fee
Banking and payment-processor compliance packet preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for foreign-entity account-opening support

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades de Panamá (Ley 32 de 1927, as amended and codified; sociedades anónimas under Arts. 1–60, including incorporation deed requirements under Art. 2, share issuance under Arts. 21–24, and compulsory resident agent under Art. 57)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Departamento de Sociedades Mercantiles)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Notarial Public Deed of Incorporation containing the Pacto Social y Estatutos), followed by inscription in the Registro Público
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. A standard S.A. declares authorized capital of USD 10,000 divided into 100 registered common shares of USD 100 par value each; shares may be recorded as subscribed and paid on the books without any bank deposit or escrow account, which Panamanian law does not require at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION I — SHARE SUBSCRIPTION. RESOLVED, that the corporation accepts the subscription of its authorized capital of USD 10,000, represented by 100 common shares of USD 100 par value each, issued to the founding incorporator, and that the share register and subscription ledger reflect such issuance. RESOLUTION II — REGISTERED OFFICE. RESOLVED, that the corporation's statutory registered office is established at the address of its licensed resident agent in Panama City, Republic of Panama, and that such resident agent is ratified to receive process, notices, and official communications. RESOLUTION III — APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS. RESOLVED, that [Full Name] is appointed President, [Full Name] Secretary, and [Full Name] Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual general meeting, and that the President is authorized to open corporate bank accounts, integrate payment rails (Stripe/PayPal), and execute automated dropshipping supplier agreements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Check and Reservation (Certificación de Nombre)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (online portal: sede.rp.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written application, in person or via the registry e-portal, listing up to three proposed corporate names in order of preference; pay the B/. 20 name-search fee; obtain the 'certificación negativa de nombre' reserving the approved name for 30 days, renewable once. The proposed name must include the suffix 'S.A.' and must not suggest banking, fiduciary, insurance, or regulated financial activities that would trigger AML review.
required_dossiers: Completed name application form (solicitud de certificación de nombre)
Passport or ID copy of the incorporator or applying officer
Power of attorney if filed by a registered agent
Proposed corporate name with 'S.A.' suffix
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar, file an amended application with re-prioritized alternative names within the reservation period, or submit a written distinctiveness argument to the Registro Público legal office; re-submission within the initial 30-day window carries no additional search fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarized Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública in the Republic of Panama (licensed notary, e.g., Notaría Cuarta del Circuito de Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the Spanish-language Articles of Incorporation (Pacto Social y Estatutos) and the name certificate to the selected notary; all founding subscribers and initial directors execute the deed before the notary; the deed must set out the corporate name, purpose (automated internet retail/dropshipping), registered agent, authorized capital, share classes, and first directors; the notary then issues a certified first testimonio for inscription within 30 days of execution.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Spanish-language draft articles of incorporation and bylaws
Passport copies of all founding subscribers and directors
Acceptance letter of the licensed resident agent
Notarial fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Material errors are cured by an executing a rectification deed (escritura de rectificación) before the same notary; if the notary identifies legal-form deficiencies inconsistent with Ley 32 de 1927, revise the offending clauses and re-execute the deed, with any additional notarial cost borne by the incorporating party.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the S.A. in the Registro Público de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Departamento de Sociedades Mercantiles)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the certified first testimonio together with the completed registry application and officer signature forms; the registry performs a legal review, assigns a folio number, and issues the certificate of inscription evidencing legal personality; pay inscription stamp duties on the sliding tariff for a USD 10,000 authorized capital S.A.; legal existence is effective from the date of inscription.
required_dossiers: Certified first testimonio of the public deed of incorporation
Registry application form (solicitud de inscripción)
Signed acceptance of the resident agent
Payment of inscription stamp duties through Banco Nacional de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an objection (reparo), respond in writing within 10 business days with a curing brief; corrections are effected by marginal note or a supplementary notarial instrument; failure to cure causes expiry of the filing, requiring re-presentation and re-payment of stamp duties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Ratification of the Licensed Resident Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed resident agent (Panamanian attorney or law firm) recorded in the corporate folio at the Registro Público
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the resident agent's formal acceptance letter and register the statutory registered office at the agent's Panama City address; the Registro Público records the agent designation on the corporate folio; the agent holds the corporate minute book and seal, accepts service of process, and keeps current the annual franchise tax (B/. 300). The registered office address must appear in all Stripe/PayPal and supplier onboarding records.
required_dossiers: Acceptance letter from the licensed resident agent
Copy of the resident agent's professional license
Registered office address confirmation and service-of-process acknowledgment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resident agent withdraws or is suspended, execute a 'cambio de agente residente' deed and file it within 30 days; late filing attracts a B/. 50 monthly penalty and registry suspension, curable by prompt submission of the replacement appointment deed and payment of accrued penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration — RUC, NIT and Territorial Tax Enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — Sede Electrónica (sedeelectronica.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, file the electronic RUC application to obtain the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC/NIT); register the S.A. for territorial income tax (ISR), advance tax, and ITBMS (15% VAT) under the general commercial regime; foreign-source digital dropshipping income is outside Panamanian territorial taxation, but domestic payment-rail settlement may trigger ITBMS filing obligations; file monthly declarations through the Sede Electrónica once operational.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the inscribed corporate charter
Passport/ID copies of directors and officers
Resident agent acceptance and registered office proof
RUC registration form signed by the legal representative
Utility bill or lease evidencing the operational address if a physical office exists
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI assigns an incorrect economic-activity classification (e.g., industrial instead of commercial/digital retail), file a 'solicitud de modificación de actividades económicas' with the DGI taxpayer services unit; the RUC remains valid during correction and no cessation order is issued while the rectification is pending.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Aviso de Operación and Municipal Business Patent Validation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Comercio Interior — Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) via VUPE portal; Alcaldía Municipal / Tesorería Municipal for the Patente Municipal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación through MICI's Ventanilla Única de Procedimientos (VUPE) within 30 days of inscription; declare ISIC 4791 'retail sale via the Internet (automated dropshipping)', which requires no physical plant or industrial license; obtain the municipal patent certificate and pay the proportional patent fee (typically B/. 100–300 based on declared capital); display the certificate at the registered office and website footer.
required_dossiers: Inscribed corporate charter
RUC/NIT certificate
Current-year annual franchise tax receipt
Completed MICI-VUPE registration form
Municipal patent fee payment proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MICI or the municipality issues an observation, correct the declared activity code or capital data within 10 days through the VUPE portal; unresolved objections may initially suspend the Aviso, but a rectification filing and fee adjustment cures the deficiency; contested municipal tariffs may be appealed to the respective Alcaldía.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Comercio Interior — Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI); no specialized industrial licensing board applies to ISIC 4791 automated internet retail
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Business Operation Notice) and Patente Municipal; no industrial manufacturing or operational permit is required for pure automated dropshipping without physical warehousing or production

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de la República de Panamá (MiAmbiente) — Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I — Exempt from full EIA: automated dropshipping and virtual retail operations generate no fixed-plant discharges, emissions, or waste streams; a 'no requerimiento de EIA' registration declaration would be filed only if a physical fulfillment warehouse or logistics facility is subsequently established
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable at formation: zero wastewater, VOC, hazardous-waste, or point-source emissions arise from digital order routing. If a future fulfillment center is opened, compliance thresholds under Ley 41 de 1998 (wastewater), MiAmbiente Resolution No. AG-0350-2009 (air emissions), and Decreto Ejecutivo 123 de 2015 (solid waste management) would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire or structural certification is statutorily required for a non-physical dropshipping operation. If a rented administrative office is occupied, the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá must issue the annual 'Certificado de Seguridad contra Incendios' after inspection, and the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) together with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) govern workplace clearance, employee enrolment, and occupational health once personnel are hired.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas de Panamá; digital services via the T@S (Tributación en Acción y Servicios) portal at tas.mef.gob.pa and the DGI eFactura / SEDI electronic-invoicing platforms.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the Sociedad Anónima in the Registro Público de Panamá (Mercantile Section) and record the resident agent and directors; 2) file the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) application with Formulario de Inscripción before the DGI, submitted electronically through T@S or through a Panamanian licensed public accountant (Contador Público Autorizado); 3) attach certified copies of the Escritura Pública, the Registro Público certificate, the resident agent acceptance, and proof of local address; 4) on approval the DGI issues the RUC certificate and activates the taxpayer ledger for ITBMS and ISR filings. Non-resident shareholders need not appear personally; a resident fiscal representative is acceptable. Non-resident digital platform suppliers without a Panamanian establishment obtain a simplified RUC through the SIMITBMS portal under Decree Law 148 of 2020.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope. The Panamanian S.A. is an entity-level taxpayer on Panama-source income at the standard 25% corporate ISR rate; foreign-source income, including automated dropshipping sales fulfilled abroad by third-party suppliers without physical or effective nexus in Panama, is excluded from the national tax base. The entity must still register with the DGI, file annual ISR returns (Formulario 1107), file ITBMS returns where applicable, and satisfy the economic-substance disclosure requirements under Decree 734 of 2019 and Law 254 of 2021 even when all income is foreign-source. A pass-through regime is not available; tax-exempt free-zone classification is only obtained by elective licensing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Panamanian law; classification is governed by Corporate Law 32 of 1927 and territorial sourcing rules. Available elections: (a) opt-in to the simplified small-taxpayer regime of Law 253 of 2021 where gross annual income does not exceed B/. 300,000; (b) application for a Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM) license under Law 41 of 2007; (c) licensing within the Colon Free Zone or Panama Pacifico to activate free-zone tax exemptions; (d) election of ITBMS zero-rating on qualifying export sales under Fiscal Code Article 1040-g.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT - ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios), Title IV of the Código Fiscal as amended by Law 28 of 1995 and later reform laws.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/. 300,000 in annual gross taxable sales is the ceiling of the Law 253 of 2021 small-taxpayer simplified regime, below which a reduced aggregate ITBMS/ISR compliance mode may be used; above B/. 300,000 full ITBMS registration, 7% charging, monthly filing, and complete invoicing obligations are compulsory. RUC registration itself is mandatory from commencement of activities without a de minimis exemption, and non-resident digital suppliers must register under Decree Law 148 of 2020 regardless of turnover (B/. 0).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing per DGI Resolution 201-008 of 2021, phased by taxpayer category: invoices must be issued through DGI-accredited billing software or fiscal equipment and transmitted to the DGI in real time for fiscal clearance via the eFactura service inside T@S; legacy electronic documents are handled through SEDI. The DGI requires prior technical validation of the issuing system; no post-issuance digital stamp is used. Foreign digital suppliers registered under Decree Law 148 of 2020 file simplified ITBMS returns and issue receipts through the SIMITBMS web portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: ITBMS 0% applies to the export of tangible goods and to designated international services effectively consumed abroad, provided (i) the exporter holds an active RUC, (ii) the goods physically leave Panamanian customs territory within the legally established transport window, and (iii) the sale is evidenced in the export ledger and customs warehouse records. Exporters may credit offsetable ITBMS inputs against zero-rated exports. For pure automated dropshipping where third-party suppliers ship directly to foreign end-customers and goods never enter Panama, transactions are treated as foreign-source business outside the Panamanian taxable base rather than as zero-rated exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) processed through VUPA/SIGA, cross-referenced with the RUC and endorsed with the customs exit record
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (electronic equivalent permitted) evidencing physical departure of the goods from Panamanian customs territory
Commercial invoice and packing list aligned to the customs export declaration and transport docs
Bank wire / SWIFT credit to the S.A.'s Panamanian or foreign account (functional equivalent of an Inward Remittance Certificate) evidencing receipt of the export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Panama is a fully dollarized economy with no central-bank FX controls, so the 180-day benchmark is applied as the internal documentary benchmark for export audits rather than a statutory repatriation deadline. The DGI matches the export declaration against physical-exit records in SIGA/VUPA, transport documents, and bank flows on every zero-rated claim. Missing or mismatched bills of lading, overstated values, or simulated exports permit the DGI to retroactively claw back the uncollected 7% ITBMS with late interest from the date of supply, impose fines of 100%-200% of the omitted tax under the Código Fiscal, suspend the RUC and invoicing authorization, and refer fraudulent filings to the criminal tax-offense track (2 to 6 years of imprisonment depending on amount and aggravation).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no issuing central bank. Banking, monetary and foreign-exchange supervision is exercised by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) for AML/CFT, the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) for financial-policy coordination, and the Comisión Nacional de Valores for securities markets. The US Dollar is legal tender under the 1904 Monetary Agreement, and the Panamanian balboa exists only as nominal coinage at a fixed 1:1 parity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility applies. Panama imposes no exchange-control, central-bank pre-approval, surrender, or repatriation requirements on either current-account or capital-account transactions. The domestic operating currency is the US Dollar, so non-resident shareholders, e-commerce merchants, and trade creditors may freely inject equity, receive dividends, service intercompany loans, and transfer sales proceeds in USD or any other foreign currency without an FX license. The genuine friction points are (i) AML/KYC and beneficial-owner documentation at the onboarding bank, (ii) US correspondent-bank screening of Panamanian beneficiary accounts, (iii) Panama's territorial tax characterization of foreign-source automated-dropshipping income, and (iv) CRS/FATCA reclassification risk if the Sociedad Anónima is deemed managed from abroad. Profit remittance is unrestricted; Panamanian-source earnings distributed as dividends are subject to the standard 5% dividend tax, while properly characterized foreign-source profits retained or distributed through supervised banking channels normally fall outside the Panamanian gross-up base if the territorial-source evidence file is maintained.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or conversion mandate exists. Panama does not prescribe a repatriation timeline, a mandatory conversion ratio, or a designated bank for export or e-commerce receipts. A Sociedad Anónima conducting automated dropshipping under ISIC 4791 may retain collections with any SBP-regulated bank or abroad, but the taxpayer must be able to evidence foreign-source characterization of the income, keep the receipts inside verified banking channels to satisfy UAF/SBP anti-money-laundering expectations, and demonstrate minimal physical substance. Operational prudence requires wiring platform settlements to a Panama operating account in USD so that source-of-funds and territorial-source analyses remain auditable by the bank and the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (USD) with integrated treasury and payment-gateway settlement
Operational Current Account (USD) and capital-contribution escrow sub-ledger
Operational Current Account (USD) with merchant acquiring settlement and trade-finance line
Operational Current Account (USD) with online collection module and ACH disbursement
Operational Current Account (USD) with trade-finance facility and FX desk
Operational Current Account (USD) oriented to e-commerce and international trade

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-medium direct viability. Panama does not recognize the EU-style Electronic Money Institution license, and a foreign EMI such as Wise, Payoneer, or Revolut Business cannot act as the primary treasury account for a Panamanian S.A. because it lacks SBP authorization and a local UAF presence. The legally robust architecture is three-layered: (i) an SBP-regulated bank current account as the primary treasury and settlement anchor; (ii) a US or EU licensed payment facilitator to capture Stripe-type or PayPal-type card flows for the dropshipping platform; and (iii) the EMI used only as a limited payout corridor for supplier disbursements. A Panama S.A. that mirrors funds through an unlicensed EMI in a pass-through pattern may trigger UAF suspicion, correspondent-bank termination, or refusal of the local account; all money trails must therefore reconcile to the supervised SBP bank statement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: De facto mandatory in-person onboarding for non-resident corporate clients. No statute codifies a universal physical-appearance rule, but SBP anti-money-laundering regulations require financial institutions to verify identity by reliable independent documents, and every tier-1 Panamanian bank in practice requires the beneficial owner and at least one director to attend an initial KYC interview, either in Panama City or via a controlled remote interview with an independent bank officer when the client is already a regulated-bank customer. Fully remote opening is exceptionally rare for a newly incorporated e-commerce S.A. and is normally rejected. The recommended path is a two-day compliance trip with apostilled certified copies of the articles of incorporation, the Aviso de Operación, the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales certificate, original passports, and bank references. After the first interview, routine treasury operations may be delegated through a registered power of attorney with specimen signatures filed at the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell-indicative structure: single-purpose S.A. with nominee officers, no payroll, and no physical Panama location.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentation bundle: apostilled articles of incorporation and the Aviso de Operación from the Registro Público, current Registro de Beneficiarios Finales certificate, lease or co-working office agreement under the S.A., utility bill in the corporate name, Panama Social Security (CSS) payroll record for the local manager, and a sworn economic-substance statement filed with the registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Automated dropshipping traffic model: high card-not-present volume, rapid supplier turnover, and settlements aggregated by Stripe or PayPal rather than direct card acquiring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Delivery of platform settlement statements for at least three months, full supplier master list with country, tax identifiers and licensing data, sample shipping proofs and airway-bill records, customer refund policy with chargeback-ratio report, and a written compliance policy prohibiting prohibited or restricted goods.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity on initial capital: founder injects funds from a third-country personal account without a documented source of wealth or source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized share-subscription agreement, 12 months of founder bank statements, underlying asset-sale or employment title documents, gift or inheritance deed if applicable, and a source-of-funds declaration countersigned before the bank compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived contradiction between high gateway turnover and near-zero Panama income-tax footprint under territorial rules.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Territorial-source tax memorandum prepared by the registered agent, DGI annual income-tax returns and RUC filing receipts, bank confirmation that platform revenue settles outside Panama and is therefore foreign-source, a reasonable transfer-pricing file for related-party purchases, and the corporate operational file evidencing decision-making substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and AML red flags on counterparties: Chinese dropshipping suppliers, free-trade-zone intermediaries, and suspicious refund/chargeback velocity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Name-screening report (World-Check or equivalent) on each material supplier, end-beneficiary certification from each supplier, invoices with Harmonized System codes, cargo and customs records, and a designated-compliance-officer narrative mapping each red flag to a documented mitigation control.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use a disciplined SWIFT routing protocol. (i) The shareholder originates an MT103 in USD to the PA_CORP S.A. account at the tier-1 Panamanian bank, using the bank's US correspondent (Fedwire or CHIPS) because Panama lacks a central-bank RTGS. (ii) In field 70, state the concept as 'Capital contribution - non-reimbursable - inscribed share issue' and reference the Registro Público inscription number; avoid vague personal remarks. (iii) Segregate the injection from operating flows by directing it to a dedicated capital-contribution sub-account or escrow sub-ledger, then transfer to the operating account after the bank has verified the subscription minutes. (iv) Deliver to the bank a notarized board resolution approving the capital increase, the shareholder subscription list, and the updated share registry. (v) For related-entity inflows, provide either a formal capital-subscription agreement or an intercompany loan agreement with maturity, interest, and repayment terms so that the flow is not recharacterized as disguised equity or a hidden loan. (vi) Preserve the founder's 12-month bank statements and source-of-wealth evidence; electronic wire transfers have no fixed declaration threshold in Panama, but transactions that appear suspicious at the SBP-defined risk triggers must be supported by a complete evidentiary file. (vii) Do not use crypto-asset transfers for capital injection; Panamanian banks will reject or suspend the account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The clearing-rail stack is layered. (1) SWIFT MT103 is the primary rail for supplier payments, freight, customs, and intercompany settlements, cleared through the Panamanian bank's US correspondent over Fedwire or CHIPS with invoice numbers and purchase-order references in field 70. (2) Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP600 are used for high-value stock purchases, issued in USD and advised through a confirming bank when the supplier requires bank undertaking. (3) Card-acquiring rails are handled by an SBP-licensed acquirer or US/EU payment facilitator for Visa/Mastercard settlement, with payout sweeps to the Panama operating account; Stripe does not officially onboard Panama-domiciled merchants, and PayPal Business onboarding is available but subject to transaction limits and reserve rules, so both should be fronting rails only. (4) Panama ACH operated by the Cámara de Compensación is used for domestic payroll, local supplier payments, and utility debits. (5) For platform payouts to foreign suppliers, the treasury procedure is to aggregate settlement in the Panama USD account and then disburse by MT103, never by fragmented EMI pass-through, so the audit trail is fully supervised. (6) Fiscal discipline: DGI electronic-invoicing obligations apply to Panamanian-counterparty sales, while outbound wire transfers require no export-surrender filing; retain the full purchase-order-invoice-payment reconciliation for territorial-source and transfer-pricing defense.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNH deliverable outright forwards (tenor up to 12 months) booked by an SBP-licensed bank with documented underlying trade exposure
USD/CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDF) for yuan exposures when physical CNY settlement is unavailable in Panama
USD/EUR outright forwards and FX swaps for European supplier and customer flows
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) for long-dated inventory financing in USD against EUR or CNH
Zero-cost FX collars and plain-vanilla currency options under an ISDA Master Agreement with collateral arrangements
Currency futures executed through a US futures commission merchant, used only as short-term macro hedges and not as a Panama banking product

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (via Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of the next fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 20 per month; failure to pay for more than one year triggers administrative strike-off and loss of legal standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta) for zero-income or territorial-source operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by March 15 of the following fiscal year (or based on RUC last-digit calendar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to USD 5,000 for failure to file; interest accrues at statutory rates on any unpaid tax; administrative penalties escalate with repeated non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Information Confirmation (Confirmation of Beneficial Owner Records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (records maintained for investigation by Unidad de Análisis Financiero)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain accurate UBO records may lead to revocation of the corporate registration and penalties under Law 23 of 2015.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Seasonal Economic Activity Declaration (Declaración Jurada de Operaciones con Terceros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Twice yearly: by April 30 and October 31 of each fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of USD 100 per occurrence; repeated violations may lead to suspension of the taxpayer identification number.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit if annual gross revenue exceeds USD 3,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 5,000,000; also required for companies where shareholders or creditors demand audit or where otherwise mandated by Law 144 of 2018; non-operating corporations are generally exempt.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or IFRS for SMEs; alternative local Panamanian GAAP is acceptable only for exempt private companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must receive a signed written confirmation from each beneficial owner, identifying direct and indirect ownership percentages, on every anniversary of incorporation; any share transfer must be documented and submitted to the agent within 30 days. This confirmation becomes part of the statutory diligence record.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 2,000 – 5,000 when audit threshold is exceeded or voluntarily engaged

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: only Panamanian-source income is taxable; foreign-source dropshipping income is excluded when the profit-generating activity occurs abroad and no Panamanian business nexus exists. Small Taxpayers Simplico Regime: 2.0% flat rate on gross receipts for annual gross income up to B/.200,000. No general corporate tax holidays.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 100 (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta) filed electronically via the DGI e-Tax 2.0 portal (Tributación y Atesorería Simplificada).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year companies, filing deadline is 31 March of the following year. Fiscal periods exceeding 12 months require DGI authorization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross taxable revenue derived from Panamanian sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Panamanian-source turnover; document territorial sourcing for all automated dropshipping transactions and exclude foreign-source margin with supporting evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales and directly allocable expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a local cost schedule; non-resident entities must allocate domestic operating costs only and preserve invoices from suppliers/payment processors.
Compute after statutory deductions; keep arm's-length allocation records for intercompany expenses and third-party platform fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax determined (25% of taxable income; 2% gross receipts under the Small Taxpayer Regime).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities generally apply the 25% rate on Panamanian-source taxable income; small taxpayer status requires formal DGI registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits, withholding taxes, and advance payments (Pagos Trimestrales).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim credits only for amounts validly withheld in Panama; quarterly advance payments must be reconciled on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay any resulting balance by the statutory deadline; refunds require a completed DGI audit procedure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fines range from B/.25.00 to B/.25,000.00 at DGI discretion; unpaid tax triggers a 10% statutory surcharge plus monthly interest of 1.5%. Repeated non-compliance may lead to business closure, jeopardy assessments, and criminal liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10.0% on dividends paid from Panamanian-source profits that have borne corporate income tax; distributions from non-taxed or foreign-source profits attract a 10% complementary withholding, producing an aggregate effective burden up to 20% in DGI interpretations.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's DTA network is limited (e.g., Mexico, South Korea, Brazil). Beneficial owners must submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC), a beneficial ownership declaration, and a treaty relief application to the DGI (typically through Form 100 attachments or specific WHT exemption request) before the remittance date; reduced treaty rates are not available without prior DGI acceptance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for use of IP in Panama: 15.0% statutory WHT. Interest: generally 0% WHT on interest paid to non-resident financial institutions for registered external loans; interest to unregistered or related non-resident creditors may be scrutinized under thin-capitalization and transfer pricing rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/.1,500,000 (approx. US$1,500,000) in gross annual revenue from international related-party transactions triggers the mandatory Local File and Master File requirement.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's ESR (Law 254 of 2021 and subsequent Executive Decrees) requires entities carrying on relevant activities (including distribution and service center operations, headquarters, and IP holding) to maintain physical presence, local management, and adequate staff and operating expenditure in Panama. Dropshipping entities relying on foreign activity must document the foreign profit-generating functions to avoid ESR classification as a shell arrangement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful omission of Panamanian-source dropshipping revenue, fabrication of territorial-source documentation, or submission of false Formulario 100 declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 2 to 5 years and fines of up to the amount of evaded tax, plus loss of tax benefits and mandatory re-audit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns or direct evasion face criminal conviction, civil restitution of all unpaid taxes and surcharges, travel bans, and lasting disqualification from directorship in Panama.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operation with no physical office, no employees, no local records, and use of a Panamanian S.A. solely as a booking center with high-margin foreign flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalties up to B/.1,000,000, administrative strike-off of the company, nullification of tax-residence certificates, and cross-border information exchange exposure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Board members and nominee directors may be personally assessed for penalties where they authorized the absence of substance; travel bans and director disqualification apply in aggravated cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Unjustified large-volume deposits through PayPal/Stripe linked to automated dropshipping flows, undisclosed beneficial ownership, or transactions with sanctioned counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of up to B/.5,000,000 per violation, freezing of business accounts, and criminal money-laundering charges carrying imprisonment of 5 to 12 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal fines, asset seizure, civil restitution, and criminal prosecution for failure to implement AML/KYC controls or for permitting anonymous beneficiary operations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming foreign-source exemption while sales are contracted, executed, or economically managed from Panamanian premises or through Panamanian payment-processing accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of the entire revenue base at 25% corporate tax, 10% dividend WHT, 3% municipal tax surcharges, plus interest and penalty surcharges of up to 50% of the tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify false territoriality classifications are jointly and severally liable for the reassessed taxes and penalties; deliberate fraud triggers criminal sanctions and travel restrictions.
